local function NewTable(table)
    local t = {}
    for k, v in pairs(table) do
        t[k] = v
    end
    return t
end

function PlayerStats:Evolution(pid, name)
    local data = PlayerStats:Get(pid)
    if not data then
        return
    end

    if not data.evolution then
        data.evolution = { growth = {}, }
    end

    data.evolution.growth[name] = GrowthKV[name] or {}

    --DeepPrintTable(PlayerStats:GetGrowth(pid))
end

function PlayerStats:GetGrowth(pid)
    local data = PlayerStats:Get(pid)
    if not data then
        return
    end

    local evolution = data.evolution
    if not evolution then return end

    return evolution.growth
end

function PlayerStats:Init(pid)
    if PlayerStats.data[pid] then return end

    PlayerStats.data[pid] = {
        Display = {
            engine_base = NewTable(PlayerStats.Display),
            game_final  = NewTable(PlayerStats.Display),
            delta       = NewTable(PlayerStats.Display),
        },
        Calculate = {
            game_final = NewTable(PlayerStats.Calculate),
        },
    }
end

function PlayerStats:SetEngineBase(pid, attrs)
    self:Init(pid)
    local base = self.data[pid].Display.engine_base
    for k, v in pairs(attrs or {}) do
        if PlayerStats.Display[k] then
            base[k] = v or PlayerStats.Display[k]
        end
    end
end

function PlayerStats:SetGameFinal(pid, attrs)
    self:Init(pid)
    local gf = self.data[pid].Calculate.game_final
    for k, default in pairs(PlayerStats.Calculate) do
        gf[k] = default + (attrs[k] or 0)
    end
end

function PlayerStats:UpdateDisplayFinal(pid)
    local d = self.data[pid]
    if not d then return end

    local display_final = d.Display.game_final
    local calc_final    = d.Calculate.game_final

    for dispKey, _ in pairs(PlayerStats.Display) do
        local flat
        local pct
        local flat_key = dispKey .. "_Flat"
        local pct_key = dispKey .. "_Pct"

        if dispKey == "AttackSpeed" or dispKey == "ProjectileCooldown" or dispKey == "SkillCooldown" then
            flat = BpToFlat(calc_final[flat_key]) or 0
            pct = BpToRatio(calc_final[pct_key]) or 10000
        elseif string.find(dispKey, "Pct", 1, true) then
            flat = BpToRatio(calc_final[flat_key]) or 0
            pct = BpToRatio(calc_final[pct_key]) or 10000
        else
            flat = calc_final[flat_key] or 0
            pct  = BpToRatio(calc_final[pct_key]) or 10000
        end

        display_final[dispKey] = flat * pct
    end

    display_final.Attack = display_final.Attack * display_final.FinalAttackPct
    display_final.Health = display_final.Health * display_final.FinalHealthPct
    display_final.Armor = display_final.Armor * display_final.FinalArmorPct
end

function PlayerStats:UpdateDelta(pid)
    local d = self.data[pid]
    if not d then return end

    for k, v in pairs(PlayerStats.Display) do
        d.Display.delta[k] =
            (d.Display.game_final[k] or v) -
            (d.Display.engine_base[k] or v)
    end
end

function PlayerStats:Get(pid)
    return PlayerStats.data[pid]
end

function PlayerStats:GetDisplay(pid)
    return self.data[pid] and self.data[pid].Display
end

function PlayerStats:GetFinal(pid)
    return self.data[pid] and self.data[pid].Display.game_final
end

function PlayerStats:GetDelta(pid)
    return self.data[pid] and self.data[pid].Display.delta
end

function PlayerStats:GetEngineBase(pid)
    return self.data[pid] and self.data[pid].Display.engine_base
end

    PlayerStats.data = {}
